name: Bludit Visit statistics
description: Collects daily visits and hashed-IP unique visitors into local logs, retains seven daily logs and exposes dashboard chart data and counts.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Bludit JSON stores and global runtime objects
metadata.overlap: Independent Bludit extension or subsystem; compose with the CMS host rather than treating internal lifecycle methods as separate assets.
metadata.deployment_warning: Unsalted MD5 IP hashes remain linkable visitor data; restrict log access and assess privacy/consent requirements before collection.
